shortDescription: South Korea is using an onerous mock trading course to cool investor demand for risky products that have made the country’s $4.3 trillion stock market extremely volatile, according to Bloomberg.The move comes as day traders abandon Korean chip leveraged ETFs in droves.

title: South Korea Uses Mock Trading Course to Curb Risky ETF Frenzy
